mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.project_code, p.name, p.status, p.priority, p.project_type, p.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.contact_person, c.contact_phone, c.contact_email, p.manager_name, p.manager_phone, p.address, p.region, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.contract_amount, p.budget, p.progress, p.description, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(p.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS updated_at, p.is_archived, p.manager_id, u.name AS manager_linked_name, CASE WHEN p.manager_id IS NULL THEN 'unlinked' WHEN u.id IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN u.status <> 1 THEN 'disabled' WHEN u.name <> p.manager_name THEN 'mismatch' ELSE 'ok' END AS manager_link_status FROM biz_project p LEFT JOIN biz_customer c ON p.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.manager_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.project_code, p.name, p.status, p.priority, p.project_type, p.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.contact_person, c.contact_phone, c.contact_email, p.manager_name, p.manager_phone, p.address, p.region, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.contract_amount, p.budget, p.progress, p.description, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(p.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS updated_at, p.is_archived FROM biz_project p LEFT JOIN biz_customer c ON p.customer_id = c.id WHERE p.is_archived = 1
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.project_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.archive_date DESC, p.id DESC
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM biz_project WHERE is_archived = 0 GROUP BY status
SELECT project_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM biz_project WHERE is_archived = 0 GROUP BY project_type
SELECT priority AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM biz_project WHERE is_archived = 0 GROUP BY priority

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS `newCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `completedCount` FROM biz_project WHERE YEAR(created_at) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(contract_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '进行中' THEN contract_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已完成' THEN contract_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedAmount, IFNULL(SUM(budget), 0) AS totalBudget FROM biz_project WHERE is_archived = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalProjects, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '进行中' AND (is_archived = 0 OR is_archived IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeProjects, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已完成' AND (is_archived = 0 OR is_archived IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedProjects, SUM(CASE WHEN is_archived = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS archivedProjects, IFNULL(SUM(contract_amount), 0) AS totalContractAmount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status = '进行中' AND (is_archived = 0 OR is_archived IS NULL) THEN progress ELSE NULL END)), 0) AS avgProgress FROM biz_project

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(contract_amount), 0) AS totalContractAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(archive_date) = #{currentYear} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currentYearCount, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(archive_date) = #{currentYear} AND MONTH(archive_date) = #{currentMonth} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currentMonthCount FROM biz_project WHERE is_archived = 1
